note: Elite foes: humanoid, themed by their chapter boss; idle 8 frames (2x4, 256px cells), stabilized.

forest-rootknight.name: Hiệp Sĩ Rễ Cổ
forest-rootknight.brief: armored forest knight in living bark plate with moss and small leaves, round wooden root shield and a stone-headed mace

forest-leafarcher.name: Xạ Thủ Lá Rừng
forest-leafarcher.brief: slender hooded forest archer in a cloak of overlapping green leaves, longbow of curved branch, quiver of feather arrows

volcano-flamelancer.name: Thương Binh Hỏa Long
volcano-flamelancer.brief: warrior in dark red dragon-scale armor with a horned dragon helm, long flaming lance, small glowing ember cracks

volcano-ashcultist.name: Tư Tế Tro Tàn
volcano-ashcultist.brief: hooded fire cultist in charred grey and crimson robes, swinging a burning censer on a chain

ice-frostguard.name: Vệ Binh Băng Nguyệt
ice-frostguard.brief: palace guard in pale blue and silver plate with a crescent-moon helm crest, long ice halberd

ice-snowwitch.name: Phù Thủy Tuyết
ice-snowwitch.brief: snow witch in white fur-trimmed robes and a tall frost hat, crystal staff topped by a crescent moon of ice

thunder-stormblade.name: Kiếm Sĩ Lôi Đình
thunder-stormblade.brief: agile swordsman in indigo armor with gold trim, twin curved blades crackling with small lightning, long scarf

thunder-sparkmage.name: Pháp Sư Tia Chớp
thunder-sparkmage.brief: battle mage in violet and gold robes with a lightning-rod staff and a star-pattern mantle

marsh-bogstalker.name: Thợ Săn Đầm Lầy
marsh-bogstalker.brief: masked swamp hunter in reed and leather armor with mushroom caps on the shoulders, barbed bone spear

marsh-sporewitch.name: Phù Thủy Bào Tử
marsh-sporewitch.brief: hunched toxic witch in a mossy shawl and a giant mushroom-cap hat, gnarled staff with green spore puffs

desert-scarabguard.name: Vệ Binh Bọ Vàng
desert-scarabguard.brief: temple guard in golden scarab-shell armor and a scarab helm, khopesh sword and round sun shield

desert-sandpriest.name: Tư Tế Cát Vàng
desert-sandpriest.brief: desert priest in white and gold wrappings with a jackal-ear headdress and an ankh-topped staff

abyss-reefcorsair.name: Hải Tặc San Hô
abyss-reefcorsair.brief: sea corsair in a coral-encrusted coat and tricorne hat with shells, curved cutlass, barnacled boots

abyss-tidecaller.name: Pháp Sư Triều Dâng
abyss-tidecaller.brief: sea mage in flowing teal robes with fin-like sleeves and a pearl circlet, trident staff

foundry-gearknight.name: Hiệp Sĩ Bánh Răng
foundry-gearknight.brief: knight in brass steam-powered armor with visible gears and pipes, piston warhammer

foundry-tinkerer.name: Thợ Máy Hơi Nước
foundry-tinkerer.brief: goggled engineer in a leather apron and brass harness, giant wrench, a small clockwork drone at the shoulder

crystal-shardblade.name: Kiếm Sĩ Lăng Tinh
crystal-shardblade.brief: swordsman in faceted crystal armor in prism colors, long translucent crystal greatsword

crystal-gemsage.name: Hiền Giả Ngọc
crystal-gemsage.brief: robed sage in deep blue with embedded gemstones, holding a crystal orb ringed by small cut gems

haunted-gravewarden.name: Thủ Mộ Nhân
haunted-gravewarden.brief: tall gaunt gravekeeper in a tattered coat and wide hat, ghost lantern in one hand and a long iron shovel

haunted-bonepaladin.name: Hiệp Sĩ Xương
haunted-bonepaladin.brief: undead paladin in pale bone and dark iron armor, skull pauldrons, ghostly blue eyes, heavy rune sword

sky-windknight.name: Kỵ Sĩ Phong Vũ
sky-windknight.brief: knight in white and sky-blue armor with feathered wings on the helm and shoulders, long wind spear

sky-cloudmonk.name: Tăng Nhân Mây
sky-cloudmonk.brief: cloud monk in light flowing robes and prayer beads, standing on a small puff of cloud

thorns-briarduelist.name: Kiếm Khách Gai Hồng
thorns-briarduelist.brief: elegant duelist in a dark rose-red coat wrapped in thorny vines, thin rapier with a rose guard

thorns-vinehexer.name: Phù Thủy Dây Leo
thorns-vinehexer.brief: witch with a crown of thorns and a dress of living vines and roses, twisted vine staff

celestial-sunpaladin.name: Thánh Kỵ Nhật Quang
celestial-sunpaladin.brief: radiant paladin in white and gold armor with a sun-disc crest, tower shield and longsword

celestial-dawncleric.name: Giáo Sĩ Bình Minh
celestial-dawncleric.brief: cleric in cream and gold vestments with a censer of warm light and a book on a chain

void-voidknight.name: Hắc Kỵ Hư Không
void-voidknight.brief: knight in black and deep purple armor with star-speckled cracks, void greatsword, tattered cape

void-starseer.name: Tiên Tri Tinh Thực
void-starseer.brief: hooded seer in a starry indigo robe with an eclipse-shaped staff and a small dark orb ringed by stars

eldergrove-blossomranger.name: Du Hiệp Bạch Hoa
eldergrove-blossomranger.brief: ranger in white blossom and bark leather armor, flower-bud hood, short twin blades of polished wood

glacier-blizzardmage.name: Pháp Sư Bão Tuyết
glacier-blizzardmage.brief: frost mage in a thick white and ice-blue cloak with snowflake runes and an owl-feather mantle, staff with a blizzard orb

stormspire-voltlancer.name: Thương Kỵ Lôi Dực
stormspire-voltlancer.brief: lancer in gold and blue armor with gryphon-wing pauldrons and a lightning lance

stormspire-stormshaman.name: Pháp Sư Tế Bão
stormspire-stormshaman.brief: storm shaman with a feathered headdress, totem staff crackling with lightning, rune-painted robes

mycelium-mycoknight.name: Hiệp Sĩ Nấm
mycelium-mycoknight.brief: knight in armor grown from mushroom caps and fungal plates, spore-dripping morning star

moonkeep-eclipsehuntress.name: Nữ Thợ Săn Nhật Thực
moonkeep-eclipsehuntress.brief: huntress in dark violet leather with moon-silver trim and a panther-ear hood, twin crescent daggers

forest-mossdruid.name: Đạo Sĩ Rêu Đá
forest-mossdruid.brief: a stooped old druid with a beard and cloak of thick hanging green moss, a stone-slab mask with two glowing amber eyes, bare root-like arms, flat stones strung across the chest, holding a gnarled staff grown from one root, topped by a glowing green stone

forest-stagchief.name: Thủ Lĩnh Gạc Đá
forest-stagchief.brief: a towering broad-shouldered clan chief with a stag skull helm carrying huge antlers of grey stone wrapped in moss, a bear-fur mantle over bark armour, leather straps with green gems, gripping a great two-handed stone axe

volcano-slagarcher.name: Cung Thủ Hắc Diệu
volcano-slagarcher.brief: a lean archer in black obsidian-plate armour with glowing orange seams, a horned half-helm, a short ash-grey cape, a tall bow of black volcanic glass with a string of molten orange, and a quiver of burning arrows on the back

volcano-drakewarlord.name: Long Tướng Dung Nham
volcano-drakewarlord.brief: a huge dragon-blooded warlord with a horned reptile head, red scales, heavy black and bronze plate with lava-glowing seams, a tattered burning cape and a massive jagged obsidian cleaver held in both hands

ice-foxhuntress.name: Thợ Săn Hồ Tuyết
ice-foxhuntress.brief: a slim huntress wearing a white fox mask with blue markings, a white fox-fur hood and tail, pale blue leather armour, and a long pale-blue ice bow with a silver string

ice-moonjarl.name: Tướng Quân Bạch Nguyệt
ice-moonjarl.brief: a massive general in white and silver plate with a heavy white bear-fur mantle, a closed helm crowned by a crescent moon, a long pale beard of frost, and a great double-bladed moon axe of blue ice held in both hands

thunder-boltgunner.name: Nỏ Thủ Sấm Sét
thunder-boltgunner.brief: a nimble crossbowman in dark indigo leather and copper plates, a wide-brimmed storm hat, goggles lit yellow, a short cape, and a heavy copper crossbow crackling with small yellow sparks along its arms

thunder-stormmaul.name: Đại Tướng Lôi Chùy
thunder-stormmaul.brief: a giant warrior in heavy indigo and gold plate with a lion-crested helm, a storm-blue cape, thick gauntlets and a colossal two-handed maul with a yellow glowing core in its head

marsh-toadshaman.name: Pháp Sư Cóc Đầm
marsh-toadshaman.brief: a squat toad-headed shaman with wide yellow eyes, warty olive skin, a cloak of dry reeds and rags, strings of bones and small skulls, holding up a big bubbling gourd rattle in both hands

marsh-bogwarlord.name: Thủ Lĩnh Bùn Đen
marsh-bogwarlord.brief: a huge hulking ogre-like warlord caked in black mud and dripping moss, a crown of reeds and bone, one tusk, rusted chest plate, swinging an enormous waterlogged tree-trunk club bound with iron bands

desert-sunarcher.name: Cung Thủ Mặt Trời
desert-sunarcher.brief: a tall archer in white linen wrappings and gold collar, a falcon-beaked gold mask, a teal sash, and a great curved golden bow shaped like two falcon wings

desert-sphinxguard.name: Tướng Nhân Sư
desert-sphinxguard.brief: a powerful lion-headed general with a thick golden mane, a striped blue and gold royal headdress, gold breastplate and greaves, a pleated white kilt and a long golden glaive with a scarab at its blade

abyss-harpooner.name: Thợ Săn Lao Móc
abyss-harpooner.brief: a wiry sea hunter with grey shark skin, a coral-crusted leather harness, a rope coiled over the shoulder, fins along the arms, aiming a big wooden harpoon crossbow tipped with a barbed bone hook

abyss-krakenlord.name: Thuyền Trưởng Xúc Tu
abyss-krakenlord.brief: a huge drowned sea captain with a beard of thick teal octopus tentacles, a barnacled tricorn hat, a long rotting navy coat with gold buttons, and a rusted ship's anchor carried as a two-handed weapon on a chain

foundry-steamgunner.name: Pháo Thủ Hơi Nước
foundry-steamgunner.brief: a stout gunner in a brass diving-style helmet with a round glass visor, a leather apron, thick gloves, brass tanks on the back joined by pipes to a big flared brass steam cannon held at the hip

foundry-chiefengineer.name: Kỹ Sư Trưởng Tia Lửa
foundry-chiefengineer.brief: a tall imposing chief engineer in a long brown leather coat with brass plates and a large gear on the back, tall top hat with goggles, a mechanical left arm, and a tall copper coil staff with a glowing orange spark ball at the top

crystal-prismarcher.name: Cung Thủ Lăng Kính
crystal-prismarcher.brief: a graceful archer in sleek blue crystal plates over a dark blue bodysuit, a crest of tall cyan shards on the head, a faceted visor, and a long crystal bow with a thin white string of light

crystal-geodeguard.name: Tướng Tinh Giáp
crystal-geodeguard.brief: a giant mantis-like humanoid general in thick dark armour split by geodes of bright cyan crystal, four-horned crest, broad shoulders, holding two long curved crystal sickle blades

haunted-banshee.name: Nữ Vong Than Khóc
haunted-banshee.brief: a thin floating ghost woman with long white hair streaming upward, a tattered grey burial gown, hollow glowing blue-green eyes, a mouth open in a wail, holding a cracked pale blue spirit lantern-orb in both hands, her hem fading into solid torn cloth strips

haunted-necrolord.name: Vu Sư Xương Trắng
haunted-necrolord.brief: a tall imposing skeletal necromancer in a high-collared black robe with iron bone-trim, a crown of ribs, cold blue-green fire in its eye sockets, holding a tall staff topped with a horned skull and a blue-green flame

sky-galearcher.name: Cung Thủ Phong Vân
sky-galearcher.brief: a light agile archer with small white wings on the back, a sky-blue tunic with white feather shoulders, a beaked half-mask, long scarf, and a slender white bow shaped like a bird's spread wing

sky-tempestmage.name: Pháp Sư Bão Cánh
sky-tempestmage.brief: a tall stern storm mage in layered sky-blue and white robes with great feathered shoulders, a hood shaped like an eagle's head, a yellow-eyed face, holding a tall staff with a spinning ring of wind vanes at its head

thorns-rosearcher.name: Cung Thủ Hồng Gai
thorns-rosearcher.brief: an elegant archer in dark green leaf-and-thorn armour, a wide hat with a big crimson rose, a short petal cape, and a long dark green bow twisted from one thorned stem with a rose bloom at the grip

thorns-bramblewarden.name: Thống Lĩnh Bụi Gai
thorns-bramblewarden.brief: a massive knight in black iron plate overgrown by thick thorned vines and crimson roses, a helm with a rose-shaped visor, a long thorn cape, and a huge greatsword bound in thorns along its blade

celestial-choirmaid.name: Nữ Tu Thánh Ca
celestial-choirmaid.brief: a serene temple singer in white and cream robes with gold trim, a small halo ring over a veil, small cream wings at the shoulders, her eyes closed, holding a large golden harp in both hands, its strings glowing warm white

celestial-dawnlegate.name: Thiên Tướng Bình Minh
celestial-dawnlegate.brief: a towering armoured angel general in gold and white plate with four great cream wings, a sun-rayed closed helm, a red plume, and a long golden halberd with a sun-shaped blade held in both hands

void-riftstalker.name: Sát Thủ Khe Nứt
void-riftstalker.brief: a lean masked assassin in skin-tight black-indigo armour scattered with tiny white stars, a pale smooth mask with one glowing deep-blue slit, a torn star-cloak, and two long thin black daggers with blue edges

void-cometlord.name: Chúa Tể Sao Chổi
void-cometlord.brief: a tall ancient sorcerer king in a black and deep-blue star-field robe with a broad collar, a jagged crown of meteor rock, a pale blue face with white eyes, holding a huge staff topped by a captured burning comet

eldergrove-petalarcher.name: Cung Thủ Hoa Trắng
eldergrove-petalarcher.brief: a slender forest ranger in pale birch-bark armour and a cream hooded mantle of white blossoms, a carved pale mask, and a long pale birch bow with small peach-white flowers along it

eldergrove-birchelder.name: Trưởng Lão Bạch Dương
eldergrove-birchelder.brief: a tall old tree elder whose body is pale white birch with black bark marks, a long beard of light green lichen, antler-like branches heavy with white blossoms on its head, holding a long living birch staff with a glowing sap bead

caldera-slagslinger.name: Thợ Ném Xỉ Nóng
caldera-slagslinger.brief: a stocky furnace worker with a black iron mask, heavy scorched leather apron and gauntlets, burn-scarred arms, swinging a heavy iron ladle-bucket of glowing molten slag on a long chain

caldera-obsidianlord.name: Chúa Hắc Diệu
caldera-obsidianlord.brief: an enormous knight of polished black obsidian with orange lava showing through the joints, a horned crown-helm, a ragged charred cape and a giant jagged obsidian greatsword with a molten edge

glacier-frostbolter.name: Xạ Thủ Hàn Đài
glacier-frostbolter.brief: a broad watchman in thick white fur coat and steel-blue plate, a full-face steel helm with ice crusting one side, a wool scarf, and a heavy steel-blue winch crossbow loaded with a thick ice bolt

glacier-wintergeneral.name: Thống Soái Đông Giá
glacier-wintergeneral.brief: a colossal ice-armoured marshal, plates of thick blue-white glacier ice over dark steel, a tall crown of icicles on a closed helm, a heavy white fur mantle and a huge glacier-ice greatsword as long as its body

stormspire-galeduelist.name: Kiếm Khách Phong Lôi
stormspire-galeduelist.brief: a tall dashing duelist in a navy long coat with gold trim and a high collar, a feathered gold half-mask, one eagle wing on the right shoulder, and a thin golden rapier crackling with small gold sparks

stormspire-thunderarchon.name: Thiên Lôi Chấp Pháp
stormspire-thunderarchon.brief: a towering storm judge in navy and gold ceremonial armour with broad eagle-wing pauldrons, a tall spired helm, a long navy tabard with a gold lightning mark, holding a tall golden sceptre topped by a storm-eagle head

soulcrypt-wailbinder.name: Nữ Tu Xích Hồn
soulcrypt-wailbinder.brief: a gaunt prison nun in a black and dark iron habit, the veil held by iron bands, her eyes bound with violet-glowing cloth, long iron rosary chains hanging from her arms, holding a dark iron cage-orb with a violet soul inside in both hands

soulcrypt-dreadwarden.name: Cai Đội Ngục Thần
soulcrypt-dreadwarden.brief: a huge executioner in spiked dark iron plate, a hood of chainmail, a bronze cage helm with violet fire inside, chains and locks hung at the belt, and a colossal two-handed headsman's axe of black iron

mycelium-sporearcher.name: Cung Thủ Nấm Mục
mycelium-sporearcher.brief: a lean ragged archer with a rust-red spotted mushroom cap as a hat, a pale fungal face with sunken yellow-green eyes, a cloak of rotten leaves and pale threads, and a crooked bow of dead wood strung with white fungal thread

mycelium-rotchampion.name: Đấu Sĩ Mục Rữa
mycelium-rotchampion.brief: a massive armoured champion whose rusted plate has burst open with shelves of rust-red bracket fungus, a helm split by a mushroom, pale threads binding the joints, and a huge rusted cleaver dripping sick yellow-green rot

geode-lodeshooter.name: Thợ Mỏ Nỏ Tinh
geode-lodeshooter.brief: a short sturdy miner in a dented hard hat with a lantern, a thick stone-dust leather coat with crystal chips, a big mustache, and a heavy stone crossbow firing bolts of bright blue crystal

geode-minechief.name: Trưởng Mỏ Tinh Thạch
geode-minechief.brief: a giant stone-skinned foreman in rough tan plate with bright blue crystals growing from the shoulders, a moss beard, a heavy tool belt, swinging a colossal two-handed pickaxe with a crystal head

hourglass-sandarcher.name: Xạ Thủ Cát Chảy
hourglass-sandarcher.brief: a veiled desert archer in cream and teal robes with brass armbands, golden eyes over a veil, a small brass hourglass at the belt, and a long curved bow of brass and teal wood with a string of flowing gold sand

hourglass-sandgeneral.name: Đại Tướng Hoàng Sa
hourglass-sandgeneral.brief: a huge armoured general of gold and teal plate with a tall sun-disc helm, broad brass clock rings turning on the back, a cream sash, carrying an enormous two-handed sandstone hammer

coralreef-anemonewitch.name: Phù Thủy Hải Quỳ
coralreef-anemonewitch.brief: a sly sea witch with a head of long orange and white sea-anemone tentacles instead of hair, teal skin, a dress of dark kelp and shells, holding a crooked driftwood staff tipped with a glowing sea urchin

coralreef-shellgeneral.name: Hải Tướng Mai Rùa
coralreef-shellgeneral.brief: a massive turtle-warrior general with a great orange-coral shell on the back, a beaked green head under a pearl-crested helm, blue scale armour, and an enormous two-handed coral hammer

moonkeep-crescentarcher.name: Cung Thủ Trăng Non
moonkeep-crescentarcher.brief: a lean wolf-eared huntress-archer in black and silver scale armour with a short dark cape, a silver half-mask, and a tall curved silver bow shaped like a thin crescent moon

moonkeep-bloodseer.name: Pháp Sư Huyết Nguyệt
moonkeep-bloodseer.brief: a tall gaunt wolf-headed seer in long black and crimson robes with silver moon-phase discs, a high collar, pale fur at the shoulders, holding a tall silver staff ending in a crimson moon orb

forest-boarstalker.name: Thợ Săn Nanh Lợn
forest-boarstalker.brief: a stocky wild hunter in a boar-hide cloak with the boar's tusked skull as a hood, a bare bark-brown chest with green war paint, leaf bracers, and a short curved stone hatchet in each hand

volcano-pyremonk.name: Võ Tăng Hỏa Diệm
volcano-pyremonk.brief: a muscular bald monk with glowing orange tattoos, a charred saffron sash and baggy trousers, black iron prayer beads, and both fists wrapped in burning bandages

ice-moonduelist.name: Kiếm Khách Hàn Nguyệt
ice-moonduelist.brief: a slim noble duelist in a pale blue and silver long coat with a white fur collar, a silver half-mask shaped like a crescent, long white hair tied back, and a thin rapier of clear ice

thunder-bellpriest.name: Giáo Sĩ Chuông Sấm
thunder-bellpriest.brief: a tall hooded priest in dark indigo robes with white-yellow lightning embroidery, a pale mask, and a heavy bronze bell swung on a long chain, sparks jumping from its rim

marsh-leechblade.name: Sát Thủ Đỉa Đầm
marsh-leechblade.brief: a thin hunched assassin with glossy dark green skin, a leech-like round mouth mask, a tattered reed cloak, and two long wet bone sickles dripping lime-green toxin

desert-jarmummy.name: Xác Ướp Bình Tro
desert-jarmummy.brief: a tall thin mummy in yellowed wrappings with a gold beard piece, a striped teal headcloth, one glowing amber eye, holding a large alabaster canopic jar with a jackal lid in both hands, sand leaking from it

abyss-sirenblade.name: Nữ Kiếm Hải Yêu
abyss-sirenblade.brief: a poised sea siren duelist with long dark teal hair, fins at the ears, a fitted armour of red-orange coral and pale scales, and a long thin coral rapier

foundry-sawbutcher.name: Đao Phủ Lưỡi Cưa
foundry-sawbutcher.brief: a huge masked factory brute in a stained leather apron and riveted brass pauldrons, a welding mask, pipes on the back, swinging a two-handed cleaver with a spinning brass saw blade along its edge

crystal-shardmonk.name: Võ Tăng Thạch Anh
crystal-shardmonk.brief: a broad calm monk whose skin is faceted pale blue crystal, bald with a gem set in the forehead, dark blue trousers and sash, heavy crystal gauntlets on both fists

haunted-scarecrow.name: Bù Nhìn Nguyền Rủa
haunted-scarecrow.brief: a tall ragged scarecrow with a stitched sack head, glowing blue-green eyes and a torn pointed hat, straw poking from a rotten patched coat, and a long rusted three-tined pitchfork

sky-fanblade.name: Vũ Nữ Quạt Phong
sky-fanblade.brief: a graceful dancer-warrior in layered white and sky-blue silks with long floating sleeves, a feather headdress, and two large steel war fans with white feather edges

thorns-shearkeeper.name: Lão Làm Vườn Nguyền
thorns-shearkeeper.brief: a big stooped gardener in a dark green apron and wide straw hat wrapped in thorns, a pale sunken face, rose vines growing out of the sleeves, working a pair of giant black iron garden shears held in both hands

celestial-judgeknight.name: Thẩm Phán Thánh Đường
celestial-judgeknight.brief: a stern broad judge knight in cream robes over gold plate, a tall white and gold mitre helm with a veiled face, a scales emblem on the chest, and a huge golden gavel hammer held in both hands

void-gravitymonk.name: Tu Sĩ Trọng Lực
void-gravitymonk.brief: a heavy-set masked monk in black-indigo robes scattered with tiny white stars, thin deep-blue rings around the forearms, dark star-metal gauntlets on both fists

eldergrove-honeykeeper.name: Người Giữ Mật Hoa
eldergrove-honeykeeper.brief: a plump kindly-looking but sinister beekeeper in a cream veiled hat and birch-bark vest, pale green sleeves, swinging a big wooden honey smoker pot on a chain, thick golden nectar dripping from it

caldera-lavadancer.name: Vũ Công Dung Nham
caldera-lavadancer.brief: a lean agile dancer in black basalt-scale armour with glowing orange seams, long ribbons of molten orange trailing from the arms, a horned mask, and a curved flame-edged black blade in each hand

glacier-mirrorpriestess.name: Nữ Tư Tế Gương Băng
glacier-mirrorpriestess.brief: a tall serene priestess in thick layered blue-white robes with a high collar of ice blocks, a blindfold of white silk, holding a large round mirror of polished glacier ice in both hands

stormspire-goldarcher.name: Cung Thủ Bão Vàng
stormspire-goldarcher.brief: a tall proud archer in navy feather armour with gold trim, an eagle-crested helm, a short navy cape, and a large golden recurve bow with a bowstring of yellow lightning

soulcrypt-cellbolter.name: Nỏ Thủ Địa Lao
soulcrypt-cellbolter.brief: a hooded dungeon guard in dark iron scale and bronze buckles, a bucket-like iron helm with a violet glow in its slit, ring of keys at the belt, carrying a heavy black iron crossbow loaded with a violet soul bolt

mycelium-sporehag.name: Bà Đồng Bào Tử
mycelium-sporehag.brief: a bent old hag in layered rotten shawls of rust and cream, pale threads in her long grey hair, small mushrooms on her shoulders, swinging a cracked iron lamp full of sick yellow-green spores on a chain

geode-quartzduelist.name: Kiếm Khách Thạch Anh
geode-quartzduelist.brief: a tall slim duelist in tan stone-plate armour with moss at the shoulders, a tricorn hat of grey slate set with a blue crystal, a short mossy cape, and a thin rapier of long blue crystal

hourglass-stormassassin.name: Sát Thủ Bão Cát
hourglass-stormassassin.brief: a lean masked assassin wrapped in cream and gold-beige cloth with only teal eyes showing, brass bands on the arms, a long tattered sash, and two curved brass daggers shaped like hourglass halves

coralreef-sharkhunter.name: Thợ Săn Cá Mập
coralreef-sharkhunter.brief: a muscular shark-headed hunter with blue-grey skin, pale belly, a pearl and coral necklace, a dorsal fin on the back, a kilt of woven kelp and two wide blades made from shark jaws

moonkeep-wolfslayer.name: Thợ Săn Ma Sói
moonkeep-wolfslayer.brief: a big grizzled wolf hunter in a black leather long coat and wide hat, wolf pelts on the shoulders, silver studs, a scarred face with one silver eye, and a huge two-handed silver axe
